'''Lion''' can refer to the following:

* The [[Lion Throne]] - the seat of power in [[Andor]].
* [[The Crown and Lion]] - an inn in [[Caemlyn]].
* [[The Stag and Lion]] - an inn in [[Baerlon]].
* The [[White Lions]] - Andoran soldiers who swore fealty to the throne of Andor, and not the [[Queen of Andor|queen]].
* [[Lion (animal)|Lion]] - the various species of large cats.
* [[Lion (horse)|Lion]] - Lord [[Orban]]'s horse.
* [[Lioness]] - [[Elayne Trakand]]'s horse.
* [[The Lion Springs]] - a [[sword form]].
* ''[[The Eye of the World/Chapter 14|The Stag and Lion]]'' - the fourteenth chapter of ''[[The Eye of the World]]''.
